cards.front: Trigger trong ART la gi va o thoi diem nao?
cards.back: Trigger la buoc cuoi cua COH: dung thuoc (hCG, GnRHa, kisspeptin) de tai khoi dong giam phan (meiosis resumption) cua noan, mo phong dinh LH giua chu ky. Thoi diem: 35-36 gio truoc pick-up. (PMID 39844247 Orvieto 2025)

cards.front: Ba qua trinh song song ma dinh LH tu nhien khoi dong?
cards.back: 1) Tai khoi dong giam phan o noan (meiosis I -> II). 2) Vo nang noan (follicular rupture) ~36h sau. 3) Hoang the hoa (luteinization) san xuat progesterone va estradiol ho tro noi mac.

cards.front: Diem khac biet quan trong nhat giua LH noi sinh va hCG?
cards.back: **LH t1/2 ~20-30 phut, dinh keo dai ~48h**. **hCG t1/2 ~24-36 gio (gap 30-50 lan), hoat tinh keo dai ~6-7 ngay** vi co CTP tail chua nhieu proline-O-linked glycosylation. He qua: hCG keo dai hoang the -> de OHSS, nhung cung de LPS hon.

cards.front: LHCGR la receptor gi va bieu hien o cac loai te bao nao?
cards.back: LHCGR (LH/hCG receptor) la GPCR 7-transmembrane, bieu hien tren: **te bao vo nang (theca)** - tang androgen; **te bao hat (granulosa)** - tang aromatase, estradiol; **te bao cumulus oophorus** - gian rong (mucification). Tin hieu: Gs -> adenylyl cyclase -> cAMP -> PKA.

cards.front: Phac do hCG trigger chuan: lieu va thoi diem?
cards.back: **u-hCG 5,000-10,000 IU** hoac **r-hCG 250 mcg** SC, **35-36 gio truoc pick-up**. Chi dinh: normal responder, GnRH antagonist hoac long agonist protocol. Uu diem: don gian, LPS chuan. Nhuoc diem: nguy co OHSS o high responder. (PMID 21450755 Humaidan 2011)

cards.front: hCG co nguy co OHSS bao nhieu phan tram o high responder?
cards.back: Trong fresh IVF cycles voi hCG trigger (Humaidan 2011 meta-analysis, 9 RCTs, PMID 21450755): **OHSS incidence ~5% (risk difference 5%, 95% CI -0.07 to 0.02)** so voi 0% o nhom GnRHa trigger. Risk difference 10% trong oocyte donation cycles (95% CI 0.02-0.40).

cards.front: GnRHa trigger: lieu, yeu cau protocol, chi dinh?
cards.back: **Lieu**: Triptorelin 0.2 mg SC hoac Leuprolide 0.5-1 mg SC, 35-36 gio truoc pick-up. **Yeu cau**: bat buoc trong **GnRH antagonist protocol** (pituitary con nhay). **Chi dinh chinh**: high responder / PCOS / nguy co OHSS / oocyte donation / fertility preservation.

cards.front: Tai sao GnRHa trigger loai bo OHSS gan nhu tuyet doi?
cards.back: GnRHa tao 'flare effect' - tang LH/FSH noi sinh trong 24-36h, sau do **LH giam nhanh** (GnRH receptor bi desensitize). Hoang the khong nhan duoc tin hieu LH keo dai -> **khong san xuat du VEGF** (yeu to gay tang tinh tham mao mach trong OHSS). (PMID 21450755: 0% OHSS vs 5% hCG)

cards.front: Luteal phase deficiency sau GnRHa trigger co nghiem trong khong?
cards.back: **Rat nghiem trong**. LH noi sinh giam nhanh trong 24h, hoang the khong nhan tin hieu -> progesterone/estradiol thap -> noi mac khong chuan bi -> thai khong lam to. **Humaidan 2011**: delivery rate difference **18%** voi hCG neu chi dung conventional LPS (progesterone + estradiol), down to **6% (NS)** voi modified LPS + small bolus hCG.

cards.front: Dual trigger vs Double trigger khac nhau the nao?
cards.back: **Dual trigger** = GnRHa + hCG **cung luc** (35-36h truoc pick-up). **Double trigger** = GnRHa o thoi diem trigger, hCG **1500-5000 IU cach 40h** (o pick-up hoac ~4h truoc pick-up). Hai thuat ngu de bi lan lon trong y van - can doc ky protocol. (Orvieto 2025 PMID 39844247)

cards.front: Dual trigger co loi ich o nhom nao theo Sloth 2022 meta-analysis?
cards.back: **Poor responders (POR) - ro rang nhat**. Sloth 2022 (PMID 34779694, Gynecol Endocrinol, 7 studies, n=2474 POR): **LBR OR 2.65** (95% CI 1.66-4.24, p<0.0001), **CPR OR 1.62** (95% CI 1.00-2.62, p=0.05). Implantation rate khong khac biet (OR 1.14, p=0.21).

cards.front: Dual trigger co loi ich o normal responder khong?
cards.back: **Tranh cai**. **Lin 2013** (PMID 23993928, Fertil Steril, n=?): dual trigger **tang LBR** o normal responder. **Keskin 2023** (PMID 37487959, RCT n=225): **LBR per ET khong khac biet** o normal responder va POSEIDON 3-4 (PG3/4 tham chi LBR **thap hon** dual 19.2% vs hCG 39.2%, p=0.026). Can than trong khi ap dung dai tra.

cards.front: Kisspeptin-54 trigger cho ket qua gi trong Abbara 2015 (PMID 26192876)?
cards.back: Phase II RCT, n=60 phu nu nguy co OHSS cao. **Oocyte maturation: 95%**. Highest oocyte yield **121%** o dose 12.8 nmol/kg. **0% moderate/severe OHSS**. Biochemical pregnancy 63%, clinical pregnancy 53%, LBR per transfer **45%** (cao nhat **62%** o dose 9.6 nmol/kg).

cards.front: Han che cua kisspeptin trigger?
cards.back: (1) Can tiem **IV** (khong SC nhu hCG/GnRHa). (2) t1/2 ngan (~28 phut) -> LH surge thoang qua. (3) **Co the khong hieu qua** neu pick-up muon (noan co the 'reset'). (4) Van la **experimental**, ESHRE 2025 chi xep **GPP**. (5) Chua pho bien tren lam sang thuong qui.

cards.front: Phan loai OHSS theo Golan 2009?
cards.back: **Mild**: bung cang, buong trung < 8 cm. **Moderate**: buong trung 8-12 cm + ascites nhe. **Severe**: buong trung > 12 cm + ascites nang, Hct > 45%, WBC > 15,000. **Critical**: Hct > 55%, ARDS, thuyen tac phoi, suy da co quan. Ty le tu vong: ~1/50,000-100,000 cycles.

cards.front: Sinh benh hoc OHSS lien quan den cytokine nao?
cards.back: **VEGF (vascular endothelial growth factor)** tang cao tu hoang the non bi kich thich qua muc. VEGF -> tang tinh tham mao mach toan than -> thoat dich vao khoang thu 3 (ascites, pleural effusion). He qua: hemoconcentration, giam the tich tuan hoan, suy than cap, huyet khoi.

cards.front: 6 buoc phong ngua OHSS theo ESHRE 2025?
cards.back: **B1**: Identify risk (AFC > 18, AMH > 36 pmol/L, PCOS, E2 > 4000). **B2**: Antagonist + GnRHa trigger (0% OHSS). **B3**: Coasting neu E2 > 4000-5000. **B4**: Freeze-all + deferred ET. **B5**: Cabergoline 0.5 mg/ngay x 8 ngay (giam VEGF). **B6**: hCG lieu thap (3000-5000 IU) thay vi 10000 IU neu high responder.

cards.front: 3 phac do LPS sau GnRHa trigger?
cards.back: **A - Freeze-all** (Humaidan/Copenhagen): GnRHa + 1500 IU hCG tai pick-up, dong toan bo phoi. **B - Fresh ET voi aggressive LPS**: dual trigger + progesterone 50 mg IM/ngay + estradiol 4-6 mg + GnRHa 0.1 mg q8h (Engmann). **C - European intensive LPS** (Engmann 2019): GnRHa + 1000 IU hCG tai trigger, them 1500 IU hCG sau 35h.

cards.front: LPS chuan sau hCG trigger gom gi?
cards.back: **Micronized progesterone 200-400 mg/ngay** dat am dao (Crinone 8% gel hoac Endometrin 100 mg x 3 lan/ngay) - gold standard. **Estradiol 4-6 mg/ngay** uong. Co the them **hCG 1500 IU SC x 2 lan** (ngay ET + 4 ngay sau) neu nguy co thai thap. Bat dau tu ngay pick-up, tiep tuc den **8-10 tuan thai**.

cards.front: ESHRE 2025 khuyen cai trigger theo nhom dap ung nhu the nao?
cards.back: **High responders** (AMH > 36, AFC > 18): GnRHa trigger + freeze-all (GPP/Strong). **Normal responders**: hCG 5000-10000 IU hoac dual trigger neu can (Strong). **Low responders** (POSEIDON 3-4): Dual trigger hoac hCG 10000 IU + LPS aggressive (Conditional). **Fertility preservation**: Random start + GnRHa trigger (Strong). (PMID 41732035)

cards.front: Dieu gi moi trong ESHRE 2025 lien quan den trigger?
cards.back: (1) **'Mild stimulation' bi loai** khoi khuyen cao (definition ICMART qua heterogeneous). (2) **FSH > 300 IU cho low responder = Strong NOT recommended**. (3) **DuoStim** duoc nang len **Strong** cho oocyte accumulation. (4) Thu tu **'POOR' -> 'LOW' response** (khong doi classification).

cards.front: Empty follicle syndrome (EFS): dinh nghia va tan suat?
cards.back: Khong thu duoc noan du da choc hut day du cac nang, **khong lien quan den sai sot ky thuat**. **Tan suat 0.38%** (Luo 2024, PMID 39055059, n=14,066). **Genuine EFS**: beta-hCG sau trigger thap (< 40 IU/L). **Pseudo EFS**: beta-hCG binh thuong nhung khong thay noan. PCOS la **aOR 2.67**.

cards.front: Cach xu tri Empty Follicle Syndrome?
cards.back: (1) Doi 3-6 gio roi **re-aspiration** (mot so tru hop se co noan). (2) **Rescue dual trigger** neu beta-hCG thap: tiem GnRHa + 5000 IU hCG, pick-up 36h sau. (3) **Lok 2003** (PMID 14507824) - case report dau tien ve rescue bang GnRHa. Can phan biet genuine vs pseudo EFS de lua chon phuong an.

cards.front: Cac yeu to nguy co gay suboptimal oocyte yield khi GnRHa trigger?
cards.back: **LH baseline thap < 2 IU/L** tai start of stimulation (Popovic-Todorovic 2019, PMID 31560740). Predict suboptimal yield. Xu tri: **rescue** bang tiem hCG 5000 IU ngay + pick-up 36h sau. Tan suat failure ~1-2% khi LH baseline thap hoac pituitary kem dap ung voi GnRHa.

cards.front: Trigger cho fertility preservation (benh nhan ung thu) co gi dac biet?
cards.back: (1) **Random start protocol** - bat dau kich thich bat ky ngay nao cua chu ky. (2) **GnRHa trigger** (khong dung hCG vi nguy co OHSS + an toan noi tiet). (3) **Letrozole** ket hop de giam E2 (dac biet ER+ breast cancer). (4) Trung/trung phoi/trung mo buong trung. ESHRE 2025: Strong recommendation.

cards.front: Trigger cho oocyte donation nen chon loai nao?
cards.back: **GnRHa trigger** cho donor (giam OHSS cho nguoi tre khoe manh). Recipient synchronization: progesterone bat dau **1 ngay truoc pick-up** cua donor. ESHRE 2025: **Strong recommendation**. Trong oocyte donation cycles, Humaidan 2011 cho thay risk difference OHSS la **10% (95% CI 0.02-0.40)** so voi hCG - rat co y nghia.
